cohort: The study included all women who delivered at or were referred to Dr Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences and underwent a peripartum hysterectomy between January 2020 and December 2022.
finding: The incidence of emergency peripartum hysterectomies was 2.39/1000 deliveries, with rupture uterus (44.11%) and PPH (35.29%) being the main indications.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean delivery was identified as a risk factor for placenta accreta spectrum disorders, which contributed to the risk of peripartum hysterectomy.
